title: Evaluating More with Less: Black-Box Test Selection for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic software systems are increasingly used in development, where changes to the model, prompt, scaffold, tools, or execution environment require repeated testing. Test case selection (TCS) can reduce testing costs while providing estimates of agent performance or exposing failures early. Although TCS has been studied for deep neural networks and LLM code models, prior work does not directly address agentic systems and often requires model information unavailable for proprietary agents. We present the first empirical study of black-box TCS for agentic software systems. We treat each benchmark task as a test case and adapt black-box regression-testing techniques using selection criteria based on task descriptions, metadata, code fragments, and embeddings. We also propose strategies that estimate task difficulty using heuristic features or independent LLM-as-judge assessments. Our strategies select tasks without executing the target age

translated_title: 以少胜多：面向 AI 智能体的黑盒测试选择
translated_abstract: 智能体软件系统在开发中的应用日益增多，而模型、提示词、脚手架、工具或执行环境的任何变更都需要进行反复测试。测试用例选择（TCS）可以在降低测试成本的同时，估计智能体的性能或尽早暴露故障。尽管针对深度神经网络和大语言模型代码生成模型的测试用例选择已有研究，但先前的工作并未直接针对智能体系统，且通常需要专有智能体无法获取的模型内部信息。我们提出了首个针对智能体软件系统的黑盒测试用例选择实证研究。我们将每个基准测试任务视为一个测试用例，基于任务描述、元数据、代码片段和嵌入向量等选择标准，对黑盒回归测试技术加以改编。我们还提出了利用启发式特征或独立的 LLM 评审来估计任务难度的策略。我们的策略无需执行目标智能体即可完成测试任务的选择。
tldr: 本文首次对智能体软件系统的黑盒测试用例选择进行了实证研究，提出基于任务描述、元数据、代码片段、嵌入向量及任务难度估计的选择策略，无需执行目标智能体即可降低测试成本并有效评估智能体性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of black-box test case selection for agentic software systems, proposing strategies based on task descriptions, metadata, code fragments, embeddings, and task difficulty estimation that reduce testing costs and estimate agent performance without executing the target agent.
